newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Nutreco starts JV with Yamaha.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Nutreco starts JV with Yamaha.

text.p: Dutch unlisted animal and fish feeds group Nutreco Holding NV said on Tuesday it would be expanding its Japanese operations through a joint venture and sales agreement with Yamaha Motor Corp.
Yamaha would become the exclusive sales partner of Nutreco feed for farmed fish in Japan, Nutreco said in a statement.
A joint venture, Yamaha Nutreco Aquatech, would also aim to improve the growth and quality of farmed fish in Japan.

"The agreement with Yamaha will offer Nutreco's extruded feed to Japanese fish farmers on a greater scale. This feed allows the fish to grow faster and at a lower production cost," the statement said.
Nutreco Aquaculture is the world's leading fish feed manufacturer with 40 percent of the global market, it said.
Nutreco emerged in 1994 from a $425 million management buy-out of British Petroleum's nutrition unit.
